question: Can the disjointly confirmed attention11 and attention15 suffix terms each be compressed to four heads selected on one half and validated on the other?
data_status: No per-head attention11 or attention15 intervention outcome has been computed on either split. Aggregate module-factorial outcomes are open, but they do not reveal head identity or selected-set compression.

population_split.selection: First 16 A1/A2 rows in builder order.
population_split.confirmation: Last 16 A1/A2 rows in builder order.

frozen_design.selection_score: 0.5 * ((singleton - no_heads) + (all_heads - leave_one_out)); ties resolve to lower head index.
frozen_design.fixed_context: Full carried and MLP boundary deltas are present in every head arm; only the projected attention delta varies.

predictions.pred_a_authority_split_capability_and_ex: All hashes/terminals, split hashes/balance, native capability, native/manual, MLP4 tensor, attention projection, and all-head/direct crossing closures pass fixed tolerances.
predictions.pred_b_writer_recurrence: Selection and confirmation writer means recur with positive A1/A2 means and at least 0.75 direction; pooled writer is within 0.01 of 0.2835613798.
predictions.pred_c_positive_selection_attention: On selection rows, all-head minus no-head attention recovery is positive at both boundaries and each frozen rule returns exactly four distinct heads.
predictions.pred_d_disjoint_four_head_compression: On confirmation rows, each selected four-head set retains at least 65% of the all-head-minus-no-head attention increment and has a positive increment in both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_e_exact_coverage: Selection arms and writer plus confirmation arms and writer produce exactly 768 finite records within 108 forwards and 896 example evaluations, without fits, backwards, or updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: promote the two four-head suffix attention sets and proceed to source-term identity.
terminal.null: The run is valid and attention modules recur, but one selected four-head set fails disjoint compression.
terminal.invalid: Authority, split, capability, alignment, instrument, writer recurrence, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

efficiency: One model load and paired head captures serve both boundaries and both split phases; exact nine-head factorials are avoided in favor of frozen singleton/necessity selection plus disjoint compression.
novelty: First leakage-controlled prospective head compression of the two confirmed material suffix attention amplifiers.
